name: native-html5-stack
description: Build beautiful, framework-free sites with HTMX 2.x, the Web Animations API, and the HTML5 Native Design primitives. Together these three skills provide: server-rendered interactivity, native motion (WAAPI, scroll-driven CSS, View Transitions), and a modern UI primitive vocabulary (Popover, `<dialog>`, container queries, `:has()`, Web Components). The no-framework stack for sites that should feel indistinguishable from a SPA without shipping 200+ KB of JS.
